profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software Engineer with expertise in both front-end and back-end technologies. Experience in developing applications across health analytics, education, and agriculture sectors. Adept at complete lifecycle management, from initial concept to deployment, with strong project management skills.

positions.title: Consulting Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborate with an international development team, offering expertise and guidance as a consultant for Dataworks.
- Conduct code reviews to ensure quality and adherence to best practices within the team.
- Share insights and lessons learned from previous work on the application to enhance project outcomes.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained custom CRM, enhancing efficiency and achieving measurable improvements.
• Managed PostgreSQL database and Heroku Server to ensure stability as well as integrity of data.
• Collaborate with teams to implement software changes, resulting in significant process optimization. This includes both front-end and back-end bug fixes and feature implementation.
• Analyze client's needs to deliver tailored software strategies, improving system performance.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Python (Programming Language) · Django · Heroku · Celery · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML5 · JavaScript · jQuery

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Spearheaded development projects utilizing Python/Django and REST APIs, demonstrating expertise in backend development.
- Executed front-end and full-stack tasks, ensuring seamless integration of user interfaces with backend functionality.
- Managed databases and optimized data storage and retrieval processes for improved system performance.
- Facilitated client interactions, translating technical requirements into actionable project plans and delivering solutions that exceed expectations.
- Utilized project management tools such as Jira and Trello to organize tasks, track progress and ensure timely delivery of projects.
- Implemented version control best practices using Git/Github/Gitlabs, fostering collaboration and codebase integrity.
- Engaged in server management duties using Heroku, ensuring smooth operations and proactive resolution of technical issues.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Python (Programming Language) · Django · HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · PostgreSQL · SQL · MySQL · jQuery

positions.title: Process Assistant
positions.description:
- Oversaw daily department operations, effectively allocating labor resources to meet production goals and maintain operational efficiency.
- Led team meetings to communicate objectives, delegate tasks, and foster a collaborative work environment conducive to high performance.
- Assigned job duties to associates in the pick and quality process paths, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and individual strengths.
- Implemented robust tracking and reporting systems for labor hours, enabling accurate performance evaluation and informed decision-making.
- Championed continuous improvement initiatives to streamline processes, optimize workflows, and enhance productivity.
- Provided mentorship and support to team members, fostering professional development and cultivating a culture of excellence.
- Collaborated cross-functionally with other departments to coordinate activities, resolve issues, and drive overall operational success.
positions.insights: Skills: Management · Team Management · Operations Management

positions.title: Supply  Associate
positions.description: Responsible for ordering, receiving and allocating vehicle parts from vendors, dealers and manufacturers to each vehicle going through the production line to provide a quality product for our customers. Maintaining a clean and safe supply room to ensure parts are distributed in a timely manner. Speak with multiple distributers both in person, over the phone and email.

positions.title: Sales Consultant
positions.description: Provide customers world class customer service with their vehicle buying and selling needs. Assist in guiding customers to make a decision based on their needs and wants. Able to use computer systems responsible for all processes related to buying and selling vehicles.

positions.title: Merchandiser
positions.description: Responsible for maintaining stock of frozen food products sold to grocery stores. Rotating products by date code and removing expired product. Traveling to multiple different locations per day often in other cities.
